response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source and Linux experience, but he falls short of two hard requirements: the role demands German at C1 while his resume lists only basic German, and it requires proven executive-level leadership, whereas his background is almost entirely individual-contributor work with no formal team management or client-facing architecture consulting. Python and UML, both desired skills, are also absent from his profile.
strengths: Extensive full-stack and systems experience across many languages, platforms, and industries
Genuine open-source commitment (GISCollective founder, D ecosystem libraries, FOSS4G talks) with strong Linux background
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing through workshops, courses, and coding dojos
concerns: German listed as 'Basic' versus required C1 proficiency — likely a hard blocker
No formal people-management or Head-of/Tech-Lead experience leading teams or client engagements
No evidence of UML expertise, Python, formal requirements management, or IT security/compliance work

key_factors.factor: Lack of formal leadership/management track record
Strong open-source and Linux engineering background
